core_obligations: Injectivity: for sections s, s' of f_a^{-1}G over f_a^{-1}(U_i) define Z_k as the closed set of points where their stalks in f_{a circ b}^{-1}G differ; if all Z_k were nonempty, the spectral limit lemma gives x in the limit where the stalks of p_i^{-1}G differ by the stalk identification (p_i^{-1}G)_x = (f_{b circ a}^{-1}G)_{p_k(x)} (proof lines 3793-3811). Hence equality in p_i^{-1}G(p_i^{-1}(U_i)) forces some Z_k empty (proof lines 3812-3813). Surjectivity: a section s of p_i^{-1}G over p_i^{-1}(U_i) comes by construction from a covering with sections s_{l,i}; quasi-compactness in the spectral space lets us take it finite with quasi-compact pieces (proof lines 3814-3824); descend the covering along some a : j -> i (proof lines 3828-3831); the pulled-back local sections s_{l,j} agree on overlaps after pullback to X, so by injectivity they agree after some b : k -> j and glue to a section of f_{a circ b}^{-1}G over f_{a circ b}^{-1}(U_i) (proof lines 3832-3839).
proof_roadmap: Prove injectivity of the colimit-to-pullback map using the spectral-space closed-limit lemma and the stalk identification (proof lines 3793-3813).
Prove surjectivity by descending a finite quasi-compact covering to some transition map and glueing via injectivity (proof lines 3814-3839).
